name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 新世大将軍
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB New World General

description.ja: この烈光頑駄無こそ新世代の大将軍
description.en: This Rekko Gundam u is the new generation of great generals.

description.ja: その 名 も 新 世 大 将 軍 な り !!
description.en: His name is New World General!

description.ja: 「伝説の大将軍編」の大将軍である新世大将軍が、
description.en: The new Taishogun of the "Legendary Taishogun Edition",

description.ja: メッキ・クリアパーツ等をふんだんに用いた豪華絢爛な仕様で、待望のLEGENDBB化！
description.en: The long-awaited LEGENDBB version with gorgeous specifications using plenty of plating and clear parts!

description.ja: 特典限定カードダスが２枚必ずもらえる！
description.en: You will definitely get 2 bonus limited edition Carddass!

description.ja: ●　新規造形で形状を徹底再現！
description.en: ● Thoroughly reproduce the shape with new modeling!

description.ja: 新世大将軍本体には完全新規造形のボディを採用！
description.en: The new Taishogun body has a completely new body shape!

description.ja: 大将軍の鎧にも新規造形パーツを採用し、LEGENDBB準拠のクオリティで立体化！
description.en: New molding parts are also used for the general's armor, making it three-dimensional with LEGENDBB compliant quality!

description.ja: ●　金メッキを採用した、豪華仕様！
description.en: ● Luxury specification with gold plating!

description.ja: 特徴的な兜の「心凰」と両肩の「技凰」、「体凰」をはじめ、
description.en: Including the characteristic "Shinou " on the helmet, " Technical " and " Taiou" on both shoulders,

description.ja: 兜・前立て・両肩・足・軍配・剣など、各所に金メッキをふんだんに採用！
description.en: Plenty of gold plating is used in various parts such as the helmet, placket, shoulders, legs, military armor, and sword!

description.ja: ●　クリアパーツを用いた色分け再現！！
description.en: ● Color-coded reproduction using clear parts! !

description.ja: 「太陽砲発射形態」で使用する頭部の結晶風防＜クリスタルゴーグル＞や輝煌の軍配、
description.en: The crystal windshield <crystal goggles> on the head used in the "solar cannon firing mode" and the glittering armor,

description.ja: 本体各所の頑駄無結晶をクリアパーツを採用し再現！
description.en: Reproduce the Gundam crystals in various parts of the main body using clear parts!

description.ja: ●　大将軍専用の各種武装が付属！
description.en: ● Includes various weapons for the general!

description.ja: 「光鳳剣」、「戦武面」、「神手甲」、軽装タイプの角飾りが取り付け可能な「輝煌の軍配」が付属。
description.en: Comes with a "Kouhou Sword ", " Battle Mask ", " God Gauntlet ", and a " Shining Gunbai" to which light armor type horn ornaments can be attached.

description.ja: 背部の大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞は変形ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The large fang gun on the back <Omega Smasher> is equipped with a deformation gimmick.

description.ja: 大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞
description.en: Omega Smasher

description.ja: 両手持ちの大砲＝三連大目牙砲＜トリプルオメガキャノン＞に変形が可能！
description.en: Can transform into a two-handed cannon = Triple Omega Cannon!

description.ja: ●　神馬凰形態・太陽砲発射形態へ変形!!
description.en: ● Transforms into Shinmaou form and solar cannon firing form!!

description.ja: 「鬼神の如くみなぎる力」、「天馬の如く駆ける脚」、 「鳳凰の如く舞う翼」
description.en: "Power that overflows like a demon god ", " legs that run like a heavenly horse ", " wings that dance like a phoenix"

description.ja: これら全てを兼ね備えた究極の戦闘形態「神馬凰形態」への変形を再現 !
description.en: Reproduce the transformation into the ultimate battle form "Shinbaou form" that combines all of these!

description.ja: 太陽砲発射形態
description.en: Solar cannon firing form

description.ja: さらに、「神馬凰形態」から必殺の「太陽砲発射形態」へと変形可能！
description.en: Furthermore, it can transform from its "Shinbaou form " to its deadly " solar cannon firing form"!

description.ja: ●　LEGENDBB 飛駆鳥大将軍と超連動！
description.en: ● LEGENDBB Super linked with Asukatou Daishogun!

description.ja: LEGENDBB 飛駆鳥大将軍への翼の取り付けが可能。
description.en: Wings can be attached to the LEGENDBB Asukacho Taishogun.

description.ja: さらにLEGENDBBオリジナルの新ギミックとして、翼と大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞も飛駆鳥大将軍に装備が可能に！
description.en: Furthermore, as a new gimmick original to LEGENDBB, wings and a large-eyed fang cannon <Omega Smasher> can also be equipped on the Asukacho Daishogun!

description.ja: 飛駆鳥大将軍が”神馬凰形態”へと超パワーアップ!!
description.en: General Asukatou super powers up to “Shinbaou form”!!

description.ja: ●　今石進氏による新規書き起こしイラストを贅沢に使用した、豪華フルカラーパッケージ!
description.en: ● Luxurious full-color package that uses newly transcribed illustrations by Susumu Imaishi!

description.ja: 取扱説明書には新作コミックワールドを掲載！
description.en: The new comic world is posted in the handling manual!
